title: Question 1
passage: A. Some containers have been arranged in a row. B. A container has been placed on top of a shelf. C. A stack of newspapers is leaning against a container. D. The lids of all the containers have been closed.
passageZh:
A. 幾個容器排列成一排。
B. 有個容器放在層架頂端。
C. 有一疊報紙斜靠著一個容器。
D. 所有容器的蓋子都已關上。
